sources.title: Enable Number Lock
sources.locator: How to use Number Lock; account-access warning
sources.summary: Number Lock prevents device transfers and porting. Disabling it requires Google Fi sign-in and credential re-entry; account loss can prevent obtaining port-out parameters.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Secure your number and SIM with Line Lock by Visible
sources.locator: Toggle Line Lock to Unlocked, Until I lock it again, steps 1–9
sources.summary: The general unlock procedure names a text-message code and a thirty-minute cooldown. It is not interchangeable with account-login recovery.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Member Security
sources.summary: Lost-device login and password reset are account-access procedures. Their availability does not by itself establish Line Lock removal authority.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Learn about Wireless Account Lock
sources.locator: Wireless versus Prepaid; how to turn the lock on or off
sources.summary: Wireless lock controls require primary or secondary access and the app on an active account device. Prepaid has its own app and SMS-code procedure; special device exceptions are separate.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Protect your T-Mobile account from fraud
sources.locator: Digital ID eligibility; Postpaid and Prepaid SIM Protection; Port Out Protection
sources.summary: Postpaid digital ID verification has consumer voice-account eligibility. Postpaid SIM Protection removal requires the Primary Account Holder. Prepaid SIM controls require the Primary Line session. Port-out protection is a separate feature.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Privacy and security
sources.locator: 2FA, lost-passkey advice and Enhanced Security settings
sources.summary: General sign-in retains password and 2FA. Enhanced Security is managed by Owners or Admins after sign-in, with password or authenticator confirmation. Abbreviated lost-passkey advice does not establish a 2FA bypass.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: My Verizon Website - Enable / Disable SIM Protection and Number Lock
sources.locator: Website controls, steps 1–3 and conditional security prompt
sources.summary: The website route requires Owner or Manager access and may request additional security steps. The page also identifies a post-disable delay; lock removal is not completed SIM provisioning.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Fix common issues with 2-Step Verification
sources.locator: Lost phone and no available second step
sources.summary: Previously configured alternatives and account recovery may help regain access. The instructions do not guarantee that email alone satisfies a particular recovery request.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: SIM Swapping
sources.summary: SIM Protection blocks SIM changes. Customer-service and retail staff cannot disable it directly; the app or website is the identified control channel.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Sign in if you lost your security key
sources.locator: No other second step or forgotten password
sources.summary: Account recovery can involve ownership questions and a contact address. This is separate from removing Fi Number Lock and completing a transfer.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: How to transfer or port your number out of Visible
sources.summary: The port-out unlock instructions name an email code, unlike the general Line Lock page’s SMS code. The guidance preserves that cross-source disagreement and does not choose an assumed exception.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text; no independent human validation.

sources.title: Suspend or restore your line
sources.locator: Lost or stolen suspension and IMEI reporting
sources.summary: Lost-device suspension and IMEI reporting concern the line and equipment. They do not establish replacement-device authentication or protection removal.
sources.reviewMethod: Assistant reinspection of official web text.
